profile.headline: Senior QA Engineer at Icario., Remote, CA (2025 - )

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.description:
Test Design and Execution: Designing and implementing test plans and test cases to thoroughly test software. 
Defect Management: Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects, collaborating with developers to resolve them. 
Process Improvement: Continuously improving the quality assurance process, including automation and reporting. 
Collaboration: Working closely with development teams and other stakeholders to ensure software meets requirements. 
Documentation: Creating and maintaining test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and reports. 
Technical Expertise: Possessing strong technical knowledge of testing methodologies and tools. 
Problem-Solving: Identifying and resolving complex issues, including those related to quality and performance. 
Leadership: Mentoring and guiding junior QA engineers. 
Compliance: Ensuring the software complies with relevant industry standards and regulations. 
Continuous Learning: Staying up-to-date with the latest testing technologies and methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Sustainability Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
●	Troubleshooting and resolving complex customer issues by identifying root cause and providing corrective actions, code fixes using C++, Java, SQL.
●	Developed automated bug resolution using an automation system testing framework with C#, NUnit, and SQL.
●	Contributed to automation test framework development using Python with Pytest and Google Protocol Buffers.
●	Assisted Technical Support Engineers (Support Tier 2) by reviewing requests, providing guidance, and supporting SaaS/Hosted and OnPrem applications.
●	Responsible for maintaining application that conducted algorithms, forecasting, and scheduling for staff workload optimization, scheduling, and predictive analytics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and implemented Clinical Simulator Software to monitor oximeter data, review captured files, and export binary data into ASCII format.
●	Defined software requirements using Enterprise Architect - UML Design Tools.
●	Developed C# software library for Philips IntelliVue patient monitoring system.
●	Created automated test scripts and test procedures for regression testing using VBScript and Mercury QuickTest Professional.
●	Established procedures for scheduling automated builds.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and implemented core PIM application user interfaces and contributed to defining features for future Palm Desktop versions.
●	Developed the Voice Memo application, enabling playback and sharing of WAV attachments.
●	Rewrote the NotePad application from Win32 to MFC, enhancing drawing management and email functionality.
●	Created the Delete Duplicates add-in, improving user efficiency in managing duplicate records.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and implemented TP-600 front-end data entry, transmission, and validation applications for multiple state Department of Justice (DOJ) clients.
●	Provided technical support for installation, hardware, and software troubleshooting.
●	Contributed to the California DOJ demo program, leading to the sale of ~200 Live Scan units.
●	Conducted training sessions for Corporate Customer Service Engineers on TP-600 applications.
●	Developed the Management Reports Feature, leveraging REXX scripts and SQL queries to generate statistical insights.
